name: Entity Reference Patterns
description: Control how autocomplete suggestion list appears when searching for entity reference field values.
project_description:
What is the Entity Reference Patterns module? 
 A Pathauto for Autocomplete fields to control autocomplete field suggestions. Change how autocomplete suggestion list appears when searching for field value (Content, User (including Author field), Taxonomy, Menu and many other entity types). Autocomplete suggestions list does not include referenced entity IDs. The reference ID is only visible in default values.

 UI provides an easy way to change appearance of the suggestion labels using Token module. The UI is very similar to the UI of the Pathauto module.

 The module is using Token module as a dependency.
